title: Card CRUD — Title, Description, Labels
description: Add, edit, and delete cards within a column. A card has a title, optional description, and zero or more labels, with createdAt/updatedAt timestamps maintained.
spec:
1. Add a card with a title to a chosen column; verify it appends to the column cardOrder
2. Verify createdAt and updatedAt are set on creation
3. Edit the card title; verify it persists and updatedAt advances
4. Add and edit an optional description; verify it persists
5. Add one or more labels to a card; verify they render and persist
6. Remove a label; verify it is removed and persists
7. Delete a card; verify it is removed from the column cardOrder
8. Verify a card cannot be created with an empty/whitespace-only title (validation)
9. Verify description/labels render via JSX escaping (no dangerouslySetInnerHTML)
10. Verify all edits survive a reload
11. Verify no `any` types and strict compile
12. Verify `bun run smoke:qc` passes
